root_cause: The intermittent timeout is on the direct relational Browse RPC and on the prepared RPC only when it deliberately falls back because the published projection is dirty or stale. The direct plan performs very high shared-buffer work and spills to temporary storage, crossing the statement timeout under load.
recommended_follow_up: Keep the prepared customer path unchanged. Monitor and eliminate unexpected dirty/stale fallback windows; tune or retire the direct fallback separately only after parity and load evidence.
